about: Minimum and maximum sizes, timings and thresholds the page uses. Leave these alone unless the user points something out or the annoyance vector says so; if you must change one, change it here (or override it in your prefs/ui.json under "limits"), never in the code. The host reloads this file by itself. `compact` (user, 11-10): every card first shows at this fraction of its size and grows smoothly to full size on hover (1 = off); `arrive-pulse-ms`: how long a new card's soft glow lasts. `spring-stiffness` / `spring-damping`: the grow/shrink spring (damping near 2*sqrt(stiffness) = no overshoot; lower = bouncier). `shrink-delay-ms`: how long the pointer must be off a grown card before it folds back.
